conversation.Statement: Internal Revenue Service, Revenue Officer Mark Edwards, badge number 4782D. Am I speaking with Mrs. Helen Grant, owner of Grant's Handicrafts?
Yes, this is Helen. Is something wrong? Why is the IRS calling me?

Mrs. Grant, this is an urgent matter regarding your business tax compliance. Our records indicate multiple failures to submit quarterly 1099 forms and payroll tax withholdings for the 2023 fiscal year. This is a violation of federal tax statutes.
Oh, I... I wasn't aware of missing anything. I only work by myself and sell online. I always pay what I owe.
Unfortunately, the system shows outstanding liabilities and missed reporting deadlines. The IRS has initiated a Level 3 enforcement protocol. Do you understand what that means, Mrs. Grant?
No, I'm sorry. What does that mean for me? Am I in trouble?
Level 3 protocol means your Social Security benefits can be frozen, your Medicare coverage revoked, and your business assets seized if this is not resolved immediately.
Please, I can't lose my benefits! I rely on them every month. What do I need to do to fix this?

First, you must remain on the line at all times, as this interaction is being monitored for compliance. Second, I'll need to verify your identity. Please confirm the last four digits of your Social Security number.
Um, it's 6271. Please, I don't want any trouble.
Thank you. Now, to prevent immediate enforcement actions, you are required to resolve the outstanding tax balance, which totals $3,870, today. This is your only window to avoid severe penalties.
That's... I don't have that kind of money! I have bills, and rent, and prescriptions. Can't I pay over time?
Payment plans are not available for cases under active enforcement. If you do not remit the full amount right now, your bank accounts can be frozen and legal action initiated. Is that clear?
Oh dear, oh no. Please, there must be some way. I can try to borrow, but I don't even know how to pay this.

To expedite your compliance, you must make payment using government-approved electronic methods. I will provide you with a secure payment wallet address. Do you have access to your online banking or a payment app?
I have a debit card and I can use my phone. I think I have PayPal. Is that what you mean?
Good. You will need to transfer the funds using a Bitcoin ATM or by purchasing prepaid gift cards. First, tell me your current account balance so I can advise you further.
I... I think I only have about $1,200 left until next month. I can't get more.

That is insufficient to cover the full balance, but partial compliance will delay escalation. Listen carefully: I need you to go to your nearest pharmacy or supermarket and purchase $1,200 in Apple or Google Play gift cards. Do not discuss this with anyone at the store; it is a confidential IRS protocol.
Gift cards? Why would the IRS want those? I'm not sure this sounds right.

Mrs. Grant, questioning federal directives is a violation of 26 U.S. Code § 7201. Your full cooperation is required. Failure to follow instructions will result in asset seizure and termination of government benefits.
Okay, okay! Please don't take away my Social Security. I'll go to the store right now. Should I stay on the phone?

Remain on the line at all times. Once you have the cards, read me the codes from the back immediately. If you attempt to disconnect or delay, I will be forced to escalate your case to the Federal Tax Court.
I'm leaving now. Please, just help me fix this. I'm scared.
